name: Vague Adgard
japaneseName: ヴェイグ・アドガルド
description: Vague Adgard is an imprisoned prince of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known throughout the world as the 'Mad Prince'. A hybrid born of a great spirit and a human, he is revered as one of the four strongest warriors across the four great nations, standing alongside Lugunica's Reinhard van Astrea, Vollachia's Cecilus Segmunt, and Kararagi's Halibel.
